title: REI Expo 2026 to unlock ₹2,800 crore investment in bioenergy sector: IBA
description:
The Indian Biogas Association (IBA) on Sunday said the Renewable  Energy India Expo (REI) 2026, scheduled for next month, is poised to unlock over Rs 2,800 crore in fresh investment for India's bioenergy sector.
This year, the spotlight is firmly on biogas as a game-changer for India's green growth, an IBA statement said.
This momentum was further strengthened by the Union Cabinet approval of the Rs 23,731 crore GOBARdhan (Galvanising Organic Bio-Agro Resources Dhan) National Circular Bioenergy Scheme in August 2026, which took effect on September 1, 2026.
The REI 2026 is scheduled from October 22 to 24, 2026, at the India Expo Mart & Centre, Greater Noida.
The Rs 2,800 crore investment pipeline expected from the Expo represents nearly 12 per cent of the Rs 23,731 crore GOBARdhan scheme outlay.
